notes.title: Scimitar not doing damage bug FIXED
notes.notes: Now, I know you are either VERY dedicated to be able to buy the scimitar on the demo, or you are cheating for money, but either way, now the scimitar works again, and you can experience it's true glory!

notes.title: Items not loading when continuing a game FIXED
notes.notes:
I appreciate the feedback from [b]VahidSlayerOfAll[/b] that helped me find a gamebreaking bug. This issue is now fixed and items should be properly loaded when you "continue game".
If you have being fallen victim of this bug, the items you previously had should load normally (as they were still saved, just not being loaded) unless you started a new game!

Please let me know if there is anything I can do to assist, the easies way to contact me is joining my [url=https://discord.gg/XbyzapGMBz]Discord server[/url]!

Thank you for your patience and collaboration!
